aborted.name: replay-1atm-fp32-nasa
aborted.reason: Stopped after >85 s wall time with no result; FP64 same batch completes its eight calls in <1 s. Strict 40bar FP32 NASA batch already had 9812/10006 failed states. Avoid further strict whole-batch repetition.

comparisons.name: comparison-1atm-fp32-linear.json
comparisons.scope:
Compare complete current-solver 1-us checkpoints, including jet-local errors.

Engineering screen for this experiment, not general physical validation:
p/rho/U scaled error <=1e-3, |dT|<=0.1 K, |d alpha|<=1e-4,
and existing conservation/phase/CUDA validation must pass.

replays.name: replay-40bar-fp32-nasa

scope: Preserve current-solver precision evidence; excludes unrelated legacy labs.

timingScopes.counters: One selected HEM launch under kernel replay; pipe percentages are not time fractions or whole-solver averages.
timingScopes.full: Fresh 160^3, 0-to-1-us, same physics; NVML only; one run per mode/environment unless explicitly repeated.
timingScopes.relaxed: Only the explicitly named tolerance copies alter closure tolerances. Same-tolerance FP64 control required for precision attribution.
timingScopes.replay: Same captured HEM batch; CUDA event includes diagnostic reduction; one warmup, repeated identical inputs.
